items.name: ouro-base
items.title: Ouro base
items.description: Add it once per app, before your first component; no component installs it, so later adds never touch your stylesheet. What every Ouro UI component needs in the app's CSS: success and warning colors, a destructive foreground, the field border color (--input) and --radius when your theme has none, the motion tokens, the press utility, the keyframes for spinners, progress bars and skeletons, and --ouro-layer, the z-index of sheets and dialogs (50; raise it in a :root rule of your own if your app has fixed bars above z-50).
items.docs: Ouro UI's base tokens are in your CSS. Your theme's values win: a variable you already had keeps its value, and you edit the new ones like any shadcn variable. This add rewrote your stylesheet's spacing once (shadcn does that for any item with CSS); no component add touches it again. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/installing.md Ouro UI v1.0.0.

@utility press.transition: scale var(--ouro-duration-press) var(--ouro-ease-out), background-color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease, border-color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease, color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease, opacity var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease

items.name: ouro-testing
items.title: Ouro testing
items.description: Installed with every -tests item; you don't need to add it. The test kit Ouro UI's tests use: Vitest browser projects with the drag, flick, tap, touchDrag, touchStep, pointerPress, emulateMedia, pageZoom, resetPageZoom, setPageZoom and restoreTouch commands, the rotate helper (which turns the phone viewport and resets Chromium's zoom; the ouro-touch project fails a test that leaves the page zoomed), the act helper, the holdFrames helper (which holds animation frames and the clock still so a test steps a spring itself), axeExclude, and the end-to-end story helper.

items.docs: toggle's tests, stories and specs are installed beside it, with the tests of everything it installs. The ouro-testing message says how to run them. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/testing.md Ouro UI v1.0.0.
